name: Streamarr
description: Stream Usenet content on demand through the Streamarr Core Server. Thin adapter — no download-to-disk.
overview: Surfaces the Streamarr Core Server's Usenet search results inside Jellyfin and makes them playable through Jellyfin's transcoding pipeline.
changelog: Move recursive TV hierarchy expansion off the search request path into a background HierarchyEnrichmentDispatcher, add an admin-configurable indexer result limit that applies live without a restart, and lower the idle NNTP connection timeout from 300s to 120s to free pooled connections sooner.
